question: Find employees earning more than 70000.
answer: SELECT emp_name, salary FROM employees WHERE salary > 70000;

question: Retrieve employee names and their project names.
answer: SELECT e.emp_name, p.project_name FROM employees e JOIN employee_projects ep ON e.emp_id = ep.emp_id JOIN projects p ON ep.project_id = p.project_id;

question: Find average salary per department.
answer: SELECT dept_id, AVG(salary) AS avg_salary FROM employees GROUP BY dept_id;

question: Find employees earning above department average salary.
answer: SELECT emp_name, salary, dept_id FROM employees e WHERE salary > (SELECT AVG(salary) FROM employees WHERE dept_id = e.dept_id);
